ValidationRule.description: The Hotel name should have "Hotel" or "Resort" or "Inn" as a keyword.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: NOT( OR( CONTAINS(Hotel_Name__r.Name , "Hotel"), CONTAINS(Hotel_Name__r.Name , "HOTEL"), CONTAINS(Hotel_Name__r.Name , "hotel"), CONTAINS(Hotel_Name__r.Name , "Resort"), CONTAINS(Hotel_Name__r.Name , "RESORT"), CONTAINS(Hotel_Name__r.Name , "resort"), CONTAINS(Hotel_Name__r.Name , "Inn"), CONTAINS(Hotel_Name__r.Name , "INN"), CONTAINS(Hotel_Name__r.Name , "inn") ) )
